law_current: Yes - Non-profit Associations Act (consolidated RT text 520062017014, in force since 01.01.2019 with later amendments incl. one in force 01.02.2023) and Foundations Act 2014 (RT 529012015010, in force 2015) both remain the governing laws; entity types MTU/sihtasutus current
fee_plausible: Yes - e-Residency official knowledge base confirms EUR 30 state fee for MTU registration and EUR 80 for foundation (State Fees Act 2018); notary 40-50 EUR for sihtasutus articles is in line with Estonian notary tariffs
time_plausible: Yes - official/agent sources put MTU registration at 1-5 business days online (row: 1-3) and sihtasutus ~5 business days, consistent with e-Business Register practice
presence_supported: Yes - RIK e-Business Register portal and e-Residency materials confirm 100% online registration with e-Residency/ID-card/Smart-ID signature, no nationality/residency requirement, virtual registered address acceptable
corrections: The row's 'individuals up to EUR 1,200' deduction cap is outdated: Income Tax Act s.11 now allows 100% deduction up to 300% of the statutory minimum wage (plus 50% above), which the row itself also states - the 1,200 EUR figure should be dropped
